title: Corn funds' net position fell 9 weeks in a row

big.label: Managed money in corn futures, positions Nov 17, 2026

chart.title: Managed money net position in corn, Sep 15 to Nov 17, 2026

moves.heading: How much the net position fell each week

chart.alt: Line chart: managed money's net position in corn futures, from 414,460 net long on Sep 15 to 33,862 net short on Nov 17, 2026, falling every week. Source: CFTC Commitments of Traders.

card.caption: Nine straight weekly declines. What changed in longs and shorts?

facts.text: In the week to Nov 17, funds' net corn position fell 11,234 contracts, to 33,862 net short.
facts.source: CFTC Commitments of Traders, Disaggregated Futures-Only, positions Nov 17, 2026, released Nov 20, 2026

facts.text: From Nov 10 to Nov 17, shorts rose by 12,250 contracts. Longs rose by 1,016.
facts.source: CFTC Commitments of Traders, Disaggregated Futures-Only, positions Nov 17, 2026, released Nov 20, 2026

facts.text: Over nine weeks, funds cut longs by 239,561 contracts and added 208,761 shorts.
facts.source: CFTC Commitments of Traders, Disaggregated Futures-Only, positions Nov 17, 2026, released Nov 20, 2026

facts.text: Record high: 414,460 net long on Sep 15, 2026, the largest net long since our series began in 2010, in contracts.
facts.source: CFTC Commitments of Traders, Disaggregated Futures-Only, positions Nov 17, 2026, released Nov 20, 2026

sources.name: CFTC Commitments of Traders, Disaggregated Futures-Only

lede.s: Funds' net corn position fell nine weeks in a row from a record high.
On Nov 17, they held 33,862 more short contracts than long ones.

poster.record_note: Record high: 414,460 net long on Sep 15, 2026, the largest net long since our series began in 2010, in contracts.

panels.title: Funds' net position in corn, week by week
panels.source: Positions as of Tue, Nov 17, 2026. CFTC released this report Fri, Nov 20.

futures.text: Same weeks in December 2026 corn futures: $5.02¼ on Oct 1 to $4.46¾ on Nov 17, down 55½ cents. Our settle files start on Oct 1.

panels.title: Longs and shorts
panels.lead: From Nov 10 to Nov 17, shorts rose by 12,250 contracts. Longs rose by 1,016.
panels.run: Over nine weeks, funds cut longs by 239,561 contracts and added 208,761 shorts.

panels.title: Against every week since 2010
panels.line: Measured against all open corn futures contracts, funds were this net short or more net short in 38% of the 881 weeks since 2010.
panels.sub: Size of the net short: 1.7% of all open corn futures contracts.

panels.title: How to read the chart
lines: Net is long contracts minus short contracts. Below zero, funds hold more shorts than longs.
panels.small: Funds here are managed money: the CFTC's name for professional money managers.

poster.data_line: Data: CFTC Commitments of Traders, Disaggregated Futures-Only, managed money in corn futures, positions Nov 17, 2026, released Nov 20, 2026. Futures: CME settles, Dec '26. Facts only, not a price forecast.
